purpose: Select control specialised for choosing many options from a list. The trigger field mirrors `Input`'s visual API (size, hover/focus/filled/disabled/invalid/required states) so a MultiSelect sits next to other form fields without visual drift. The dropdown panel is teleported to `body` and anchored to the trigger by the shared `usePlacement` composable — no `@floating-ui` runtime. Every option row carries a checkbox indicator (the `Checkbox` webkit component), optionally a leading slot/icon and a trailing tag. Search and "Create new" footer are exposed as slots on `<MultiSelectContent>`. Unlike `Select` (which toggles between single and multi via a `multiple` prop), MultiSelect is multi-only: `modelValue` is always an array and the indicator is always a checkbox. Aligned with Figma frame `3899:29362` (options panel). The trigger reuses the `Input`/`Select` trigger visuals.
useWhen: Choosing several values from a long list (regions, tags, permissions) in a compact field.
A filter whose selected values stay editable from the same dropdown.
Grouped options with icons or trailing tags, optionally with search.
avoidWhen: Only one value may be chosen → use `select`.
A labelled form field with helper/error text → put it (or `select` with `multiple`) inside a `field`.
A handful of options that fit on screen → use a horizontal `field` with a `checkbox` for each.
The user builds a subset and needs the chosen and remaining items side by side → use `pick-list`.
related: field` — wraps this control with its label, description and error; it hands the trigger its id and state.
pick-list` — dual-list transfer for building larger subsets.
checkbox` — the indicator every option row renders.
bestPractices: modelValue` is always an array; start it as `[]`, never `null`.
Pass `displayValue` to summarise long selections (e.g. "3 regions") instead of a list that overflows the trigger.
Keep each option's `value` stable and unique; selection is matched by value.
Put a search input in the `search` slot and a create action in the `footer` slot of `MultiSelect.Content`.
